name: Shorty Link Manager
author: theveloper

sections.description:
Shorty Link Manager helps you find, manage, and shorten outgoing links directly in WordPress.

The plugin can scan posts and pages for external links, process them in batches, and replace matching URLs with shortened versions.

Features:

  • Settings page for provider configuration
  • Shurli.at support
  • Automatic shortening when content is saved
  • Manual review and processing from the Links page
  • Scan existing posts and pages for outgoing links
  • Batch processing with progress feedback
  • Restore original links when needed
  • Replace matching outgoing URLs directly in content

External services

This plugin connects to the Shurli.at API to create short links from external URLs.

What the service is used for:
Shurli.at is a URL shortening service used to generate short links.

What data is sent and when:
The plugin sends the destination URL to the Shurli.at API when a short link is created.
The API key configured by the administrator is sent in the authorization header to authenticate the request.
No data is sent unless the administrator uses the plugin’s shortening functionality.

Service website:
https://shurli.at/

Terms of Service:
https://shurli.at/page/agb

Privacy Policy:
https://shurli.at/page/datenschutz
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Shorty Link Manager in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Select Shurli.at as provider and enter your API key.
  5. Use Shorty Link Manager > Links to scan and process existing outgoing links.
sections.faq:
Which shortening service is supported?

Shorty Link Manager currently supports Shurli.at.

Can I scan old posts and pages for existing links?

Yes. The plugin can scan existing content and detect outgoing links for later processing.

Can I restore original links?

Yes. Shortened links can be restored to their original URLs.

Does the plugin process links automatically?

Yes. In automatic mode, outgoing links can be shortened when content is saved. In manual mode, you can review and process detected links later from the Links page.
